# truenas_iscsi_auth (Resource)

Create an iSCSI Authorized Access.

`tag` should be unique among all configured iSCSI Authorized Accesses.

`secret` and `peersecret` should have length between 12-16 letters inclusive.

`peeruser` and `peersecret` are provided only when configuring mutual CHAP. `peersecret` should not be
similar to `secret`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `secret` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password/secret for iSCSI CHAP authentication.
- `tag` (Number) Numeric tag used to associate this credential with iSCSI targets.
- `user` (String) Username for iSCSI CHAP authentication.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `discovery_auth` (String) Authentication method for target discovery. If "CHAP_MUTUAL" is selected for target discovery, it is only     permitted for a single entry systemwide. Defaults to `"NONE"`.
- `peersecret` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password/secret for mutual CHAP authentication or empty string if not configured.
- `peersecret_wo_version` (Number) Change this value to send `peersecret` again. Terraform never stores `peersecret`.
- `peeruser` (String) Username for mutual CHAP authentication or empty string if not configured. Defaults to `""`.
- `secret_wo_version` (Number) Change this value to send `secret` again. Terraform never stores `secret`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = truenas_iscsi_auth.example
  provider = truenas
  identity = {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by TrueNAS id
terraform import truenas_iscsi_auth.example 1
```
